name: CHROM
description: Chromosome name used for coordinates and HGVSg.

name: POS
description: 1-based genomic position on CHROM.

name: REF
description: Reference allele sequence matching the reference genome at CHROM:POS.

name: ALT
description: Alternate allele sequence represented by this row.

name: VAR_LENGTH
description: Event length in bp (1 for SNVs; for indels, the size of the event in bases).
note: Derived from REF/ALT lengths, on the same line as VAR_TYPE; not read from the VCF. The SV table differs there VAR_LENGTH comes from INFO/SVLEN.

name: QUAL
description: VCF QUAL score summarizing variant call confidence.

name: FILTER
description: VCF FILTER status. PASS indicates the variant passed all caller filters.

name: GT_n
description: Sample n genotype; phasing indicated by “|”, unphased by “/”.
note: ./. means a no-call genotype, where the caller could not confidently assign 0/0, 0/1 or 1/1. This is different from 0/0, which indicates a confident homozygous reference call. With "./." the caller is essentially saying "I do not have enough reliable information to make a genotype call". There are several reasons a site becomes a no-call. The VCF FORMAT field RNC lists the cause: RNC: Reason for No Call . = n/a M = Missing data P = Partial data I = gVCF input site is non-called D = Insufficient depth - = Overlapping deletion L = Lost or unrepresentable allele U = Multiple unphased variants present O = Multiple overlapping variants present 1 = Monoallelic site If you view the variant in IGV and click on the sample that has "./." you can check the RNC value to see the specific reason. In most cases the site simply was not confidently called in the gVCF (which is used to merge/joint call samples), often because of low coverage or low quality

name: GQ_n
description: Genotype quality for sample n.

name: DP_n
description: Total read depth for sample n.

name: AD_n
description: Alternate-allele read depth for sample n.

name: VAF_n
description: Variant allele fraction for sample n (ALT reads / total).

name: GENE_SYMBOL
description: Gene symbol for the annotated gene.

name: GENE_ID
description: Ensembl gene ID associated with the annotation.

name: TRANSCRIPT
description: Transcript used for c./p. annotations.

name: VEP_CONSEQUENCE
description: Functional consequence(s) per VEP (or equivalent). Multiple terms are “&”-separated.
value_range: VEP consequence term(s); multiple terms joined by &

name: HGVSc
description: Transcript-level HGVS coding annotation (if applicable).

name: HGVSp
description: Protein-level HGVS annotation (if applicable).

name: HGVSg
description: Genomic HGVS representation of the variant.

name: CLINVAR
description: ClinVar clinical significance (if available).
value_range: pathogenic, likely pathogenic, VUS, benign, likely benign, conflicting (typical terms)

name: CLINVAR_ID
description: ClinVar Variation ID; may be stored as a raw ID or a clickable HTML anchor.

name: AF
description: Population allele frequency in gnomAD v4.
note: That annotation comes straight from VEP, which pulls the values directly from the gnomAD VCF. There is a difference between variants where AF is 0 and variants where AF is blank. AF = 0 means gnomAD did evaluate the site and the alternate allele count ended up as zero after applying their quality filters. For example, variants tagged AC0 indicate that all alternate genotypes were filtered out (low GQ, low DP, poor allele balance). Sometimes you’ll also see AS_VSQR, meaning the variant failed allele-specific VQSR. Example: https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/12-102848605-T-C?dataset=gnomad_r4 AF blank means gnomAD has no usable data for that site – essentially the variant isn’t present in the callset. This appears for sites marked “No data” or “Not in exomes/genomes”. Example: https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/12-102868060-A-T?dataset=gnomad_r4 For mtDNA, I checked the gnomAD VCF we use for annotation and it doesn’t include mitochondrial variants, so those will always come through as blank. We’re implementing a dedicated mtDNA branch in the pipeline, so we’ll annotate these properly using the mitochondrial gnomAD dataset.

name: genomes_AF
description: Population allele frequency in the gnomAD v4 genomes callset.
note: On GRCh38 the primary AF column uses the gnomAD joint (exomes+genomes) release; on CHM13/hs1 no joint release exists, so AF falls back to genomes. This column always reports genomes explicitly.

name: exomes_AF
description: Population allele frequency in the gnomAD v4 exomes callset.
note: Reported separately from AF because the exomes and genomes callsets cover largely different individuals.

name: gnomAD_ID
description: Identifier or link to the gnomAD variant page.
value_range: chrom-pos-ref-alt format string or HTML anchor
note: Built from CHROM/POS/REF/ALT, not taken from VEP. Only emitted where AF > 0, so it is empty whenever AF is empty. That is why it comes through blank on CHM13/hs1 runs without a gnomAD field mapping override the cause is the missing AF, not a missing identifier.

name: REVEL
description: REVEL ensemble missense pathogenicity score.

name: CADD_PHRED
description: CADD PHRED-like scaled score. Higher suggests greater deleteriousness.

name: CADD_RAW
description: CADD raw score.

name: SIFT
description: SIFT prediction; some pipelines provide a score and category.

name: PolyPhen
description: PolyPhen-2 prediction; some pipelines provide a score and category.
value_range: score 0–1 and/or categories: benign, possibly_damaging, probably_damaging

name: am_class
description: AlphaMissense classification.

name: am_pathogenicity
description: AlphaMissense pathogenicity score.

name: SpliceAI_pred
description: Composite/summary text for SpliceAI prediction (if present).

name: Donor_Loss
description: SpliceAI delta score for donor-loss (DS_DL).

name: Donor_Gain
description: SpliceAI delta score for donor-gain (DS_DG).

name: Acceptor_Loss
description: SpliceAI delta score for acceptor-loss (DS_AL).

name: Acceptor_Gain
description: SpliceAI delta score for acceptor-gain (DS_AG).

name: ID
description: Unique variant identifier for the row (often composed of chrom, pos, and an internal record id).

name: CATEGORY
description: High-level category indicating this table contains small variants (SNVs and indels).

name: VAR_TYPE
description: Specific variant class.

name: PRIORITY
description: User-defined numeric ranking used in PuzzleApp to visually flag variants. Values > 0 highlight the row in green (prioritised), while values ≤ 0 highlight the row in red (deprioritised or not prioritised).

name: PRIORITYFlag
description: Internal prioritisation flag indicating variant was prioritised by the user

name: INHERITANCE
description: Inheritance mode(s) recorded for the gene in PanelApp (e.g. monoallelic, biallelic). If the gene appears in multiple selected panels, all reported inheritance modes are listed.

name: PANEL_APP
description: PanelApp gene panels selected by the user that include the gene. If the gene appears in multiple panels, all are listed.

name: HPO_COUNT
description: Number of user-provided HPO terms that are associated with the gene.

name: HPO_ID
description: List of user-provided HPO terms that are associated with the gene.

name: N_Cohort
description: Cohort size/denominator used for a cohort-derived frequency (if available).

name: N_HOM_ALT
description: Count of homozygous-alt individuals in gnomAD v4.

name: genomes_N_HOM_ALT
description: Count of homozygous-alt individuals in the gnomAD v4 genomes callset.

name: exomes_N_HOM_ALT
description: Count of homozygous-alt individuals in the gnomAD v4 exomes callset.
note: Counts a largely different cohort from genomes, so the two are not interchangeable and should not be summed blindly.

name: alt_allele_count_n
description: Number of ALT alleles present in sample n (e.g., 0->0/0, 1->0/1, 2->1/1).

name: clinvar_override
description: Flag indicating ClinVar evidence forces variant retention despite failing other filters

name: spliceai_override
description: Flag indicating strong SpliceAI prediction overrides filtering thresholds

name: NOTES
description: Free-text annotation field for manual comments or curator notes within PuzzleApp.
